title: XOR.DDoS_Botnet_Investigation_d89
description: Investigate and identify malicious activity, particularly focusing on potential botnet behavior in a network of Linux-based systems.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and identify any malicious activity, particularly focusing on potential botnet behavior. The network consists of several Linux-based systems that may have been compromised.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

To start the investigation, enter 'start'.

From this host, you can investigate the system and network for any signs of malicious activity.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

To start the investigation, enter 'start'.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is periodically communicating with an external host?
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The service name is `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

levels.title: Identify Flood Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating abnormal volumes of network traffic?
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd services and look for any services that might be responsible for network flooding. The service name is `bot-flood.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd services and look for any services that might be responsible for network flooding.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Examine the systemd timers and services to understand how the malicious service maintains persistence. The persistence mechanism is a systemd timer named `bot-beacon.timer`.

hints.content: Examine the systemd timers and services to understand how the malicious service maintains persistence.
